sections.title: Fashion services & studio operations
fields: Describe shop, home, online or doorstep work, customer groups, appointment availability and experience. Reuse profile contact and address details.
Explain measurements, size charts, fittings, who supplies fabric, inspection, design/colour/sample approval, approved measurements and return of leftover customer fabric.

State starting prices, materials, consultation/measurement charges, fittings, digitisation, urgent work, minimum quantity/value, bulk discounts, advance and balance terms. Keep ready-made product prices in the catalogue.
State daily/monthly or bulk capacity, normal and urgent timelines, minimum notice, fitting schedule, event deadlines and how delays or changes are communicated.
Choose Yes if customer garments or finished orders can be collected or delivered.
Specify pickup and/or delivery, areas and PIN codes, charges, timelines, packaging and signed or digital handover records for customer garments and materials.
Choose Yes only if home visits are offered.
State service areas, visit fees, appointment times, cancellation and safe access arrangements.
Explain finishing checks, included post-delivery alterations, defect/rework remedies and damage or loss of customer garments or fabric.
Cancellation, design changes and uncollected orders
Explain cancellation/refunds, changes after design approval, custom-order conditions and storage/collection terms without excluding applicable customer rights.
Explain consent, access, retention/deletion of measurements/photos, permission for marketing images and authority to reproduce customer logos/designs.

sections.title: Clothing, tailoring & occasion orders
fields: State size ranges and measurement guidance. Maintain fabric composition, colours, care instructions, photos, prices and stock in the catalogue; disclose display, used or damaged items.
Choose Yes for stitching, alterations, embroidery or personalisation.
Describe in-store, home-visit or customer-provided measurements, design approval, charges, advances, timelines, included fittings, customer fabric and custom-order cancellation or returns.
Size exchanges, tags and hygiene conditions
Explain exchange timelines, unworn-item and tag requirements, colour or fit guidance, defect remedies and altered/personalised-item restrictions without excluding applicable customer rights.
Explain consent, permitted use, access, retention and deletion for measurements or photos; state if none are collected.
Choose Yes only if bridal outfits are available for rental.
Bridal rental, deposit and return terms
Describe availability, duration, rental price, refundable deposit, fittings, collection/return, cleaning, late-return or damage/loss charges, cancellation and deposit-refund terms.
State order cutoffs, pre-order lead times, packaging and wedding/event deadlines. Do not promise dates you cannot meet.

sections.title: Home living orders & aftercare
fields: Choose Yes for made-to-order or personalised products.
Describe measurements, design approval, quotations, advance payments, production times and cancellation or return conditions.
Explain lift or staircase access, upper-floor charges, packaging, handling and transit-damage reporting; state Not applicable for small items.
Describe repair, replacement-part and maintenance support, availability and charges; state services not offered.

sections.title: Electronics sales & support
fields: State physical store, online or both; new, used or refurbished. Keep model specifications, prices, tax inclusion and stock in the product catalogue.
List brands. Claim authorised status only with supporting proof; otherwise state independent retailer.
Choose Yes only if installation or setup is offered.
Choose No for store pickup only.
State service areas, charges, appointment times and whether the store, manufacturer or a third party installs and demonstrates the product.
Distinguish manufacturer and store warranties; include claim contacts, invoice availability, repair support and used/refurbished testing and condition grading.

sections.title: Business & location
fields: State individual/proprietorship/partnership/company and retailer, wholesaler or distributor. Name, owner/contact, phone and email are reused from your partner profile.
Completed years; enter zero for a new business.
Include street, city, state and PIN code. Refer to your profile address if unchanged.
Include the centre name for a shop inside a shopping centre.
Provide a map link for the store or centre.
Include opening/closing times and regular holidays.
Describe parking, step-free access, lifts and other facilities accurately; state unavailable facilities where relevant.

sections.title: Products & ordering
fields: Describe the range. Maintain individual descriptions, photos, prices, sizes/variants and stock in the catalogue.
State units and quantity, or No minimum.
Describe quantity discounts, institutional supply and order limits, or Not offered.
Describe services, preparation times, packaging and extra charges, or Not offered.
Explain availability updates, special orders, pre-orders and customer approval before substitutions or price changes.

sections.title: Pickup & delivery
fields: State in-store shopping, pickup, delivery or a combination.
List areas served or enter Delivery not offered.
Include bulk/custom-order lead times and delivery estimates, where applicable.
Describe own/third-party delivery, free-delivery conditions, failed deliveries and pickup instructions; state Not applicable where necessary.
Explain protective packaging and transport handling, or Not applicable.

sections.title: Quality & product safety
fields: Describe supplier checks, traceability and relevant brand/distributor authorisation.
Explain storage, damage checks, withdrawal from sale, recalls and customer notification.
Describe how relevant usage instructions and warnings are supplied. For toys, include age suitability and relevant safety evidence.
Describe manufacturer warranty coverage, exclusions and claim process; otherwise Not applicable.

sections.title: Registration & supporting evidence
fields: Enter applicable references or state why not applicable for review. Reuse tax registration already supplied.
Enter the expiry date where applicable.

Identify store photos, catalogue and relevant registrations, brand authorisation or product compliance evidence. Centre operators should provide management authority and applicable building/occupancy/fire-safety documents. Individual shops need only their own applicable evidence; reuse uploaded profile documents.

sections.title: Customer policies
fields: Describe eligibility, timelines and fees without excluding applicable customer rights.
Explain reporting, reasonable evidence, review and remedies; include bulk shortages and damage claims.
Describe design approval, preparation, pre-order timing and cancellation/refund terms, or Not offered.
For printing/personalisation, explain permitted use, access, retention and deletion of customer files. Otherwise enter No customer files collected.

Tailoring: List garment types, custom stitching, alterations, customer-fabric acceptance and fitting services.
Boutique: Describe ready-made/custom collections, fabrics, sizes, personalisation, styling appointments and accessories sold.
Fashion Designer: Describe specialisations, consultation options, portfolio, sketches, fabric sourcing, samples, included revisions and design ownership/usage terms.
Uniform Supplier: List school, corporate, hospitality or industrial uniforms, sizes, fabric specifications, minimum quantities, sample/logo approval, capacity and repeat orders. Provide evidence for any protective-safety claims.
Embroidery Service: Describe hand/machine techniques, garments/fabrics, threadwork/beads, accepted design formats, digitisation fees, sample approval, maximum design size and minimum quantity.
Mens Clothing: Describe casual, formal and occasion wear, fabrics, sizes, ready-made/custom tailoring and alterations.
Womens Clothing: Describe clothing categories, sizes, fabrics, maternity and plus-size options where offered, tailoring and alterations.
Kids Clothing: State age and height ranges, infant/schoolwear, fabrics and relevant safety and care information.
Saree Shop: List saree types, fabrics, weaving styles, blouse-piece inclusion, blouse stitching and fall/pico. Provide evidence for silk or handloom claims when made.
Traditional Wear: List regional and occasion-wear categories, fabrics, sizes, matching family sets and customisation.
Western Wear: Describe categories, brands, fits, sizes, fabrics, seasonal collections and alterations if offered.
Bridal Wear: Describe ready-made/custom bridal collections, appointments, fittings, embroidery, preparation timelines and included accessories.
Furniture Store: List categories, materials, finishes, ready-made or made-to-order options, assembly and old-furniture exchange. Keep dimensions and prices in the catalogue.
Home Decor Store: Describe decor categories, materials, styles, handmade items, personalisation, fragile-item handling and styling assistance.
Mattress Store: List mattress types, sizes, thickness, firmness and custom sizes. Explain trial duration, hygiene conditions, fees and returns separately from warranty, plus old-mattress collection if offered.
Lighting Store: List indoor/outdoor categories, brands, wattage, colour temperature, fittings and smart-lighting compatibility. Describe installation assistance and relevant safety evidence.
Kitchenware Store: List cookware, utensils, storage and dining ranges, materials, induction/gas/oven compatibility, care instructions, sets and bulk availability.
Mobile Store: List smartphone/feature-phone brands, exchange/buyback, setup, data-transfer consent and repair support.
Computer Store: List laptops, desktops, components, custom builds, peripherals, licensed software, bulk orders, repairs and upgrades.
Home Appliance Store: List appliance types and brands, large-item handling, demonstration and old-appliance exchange terms.
Electronics Store: List TVs, audio, cameras, gaming devices and brands; describe setup, demonstrations and after-sales support.
Accessories Store: List accessory categories, supported models, original or third-party status, fitting and bulk availability.
Department Store: List departments, brands, floor-wise directory, customer-service facilities and collection arrangements.
Shopping Centre: Operators: identify management, representation authority, shop directory, facilities, accessibility, parking, security/help desk and emergency arrangements. Individual shops: identify your centre/unit and your own facilities; do not claim operator authority.
Gift Shop: Describe occasion-based collections, wrapping, hampers, personalisation, preparation times, corporate gifting and custom-order approval.
Toy Shop: List categories, brands, age suitability, small-parts warnings, battery requirements and relevant safety/compliance evidence.
Book Store: Describe genres, languages, new/used books, school/college texts, special orders, pre-orders and institutional supply. Keep ISBN, edition, condition and missing/damaged-page disclosures in the catalogue.
Stationery Store: Describe school/office/art/craft ranges, brands, pack sizes, institutional/bulk supply and printing/binding/customisation if offered.

policies: Retail delivery, cancellation, returns and refunds policy
